documents.title: Documents
documents.dropHint: Drop .pdf / .docx here, or click to choose (multiple allowed)
documents.pasteHint: Fallback when parsing fails: paste the text, clauses are split by numbering
documents.neverExtractedHint: This document has never produced a single extraction proposal — not “proposed and rejected”, but never run. Nothing in it is in the control library.
documents.uncoveredHint: Heuristic: clauses containing shall / must / should that no control cites. It over-reports (scope statements) and under-reports (tables carry obligations without modal verbs).
documents.blindSpotHint: Whether your own documents have been turned into controls. The opposite direction from framework coverage.

search.title: Search
search.placeholder: Search policy clauses, Chinese or English
search.keywordOnly: Keyword search only (semantic search unavailable: no embedding provider configured, or the index is incomplete)
search.indexIncomplete: Index incomplete; results may be incomplete

review.title: Review queue
review.bulkResult: Accepted {{accepted}}; skipped {{skipped}} under current eligibility rules.
review.previewReadOnly: This preview is read-only. Only the execution button below writes formal results.
review.previewImpact: Execution is expected to add {{mappings}} formal mappings and {{relations}} formal relationships.
review.autoConfirmCount: {{count}} proposals will be accepted automatically with a complete audit trail. Continue?
review.autoConfirm: Only proposals that pass hard validation and the high-confidence threshold will be accepted automatically. Continuous samples will be retained. Continue?
review.autoResult: Scanned {{scanned}}; automatically accepted {{accepted}}; sampled {{sample}}, exception review {{manual}}, deferred {{deferred}}, skipped {{skipped}}.

tierHints.sample: This proposal is part of continuous quality sampling and needs human review.
tierHints.manual: A source or context risk requires human review.
tierHints.deferred: No immediate action is required; this stays out of formal compliance data until verified.

review.ocrSuspect: OCR quality is uncertain. Review this proposal individually.
review.empty: No pending proposals in this view
review.readOnly: You can browse proposals. Decisions require a GRC Lead or administrator.
review.limit: Showing the first 200 proposals, lowest confidence first. Filter by type or review these to see more.
review.manualOnly: Individual review required by the current eligibility rules.
review.eligibilityUnknown: Batch eligibility is unavailable. Review individually or refresh.
review.mappingEvidence: Check the column mapping against the original spreadsheet. Import uses the approved mapping and creates control proposals for review.
review.claimMapping: Left: the external framework requirement · Right: your internal control. The claim: this control {{strength}} that requirement.
review.claimRelation: Both sides are your internal controls. The claim: they are related as “{{relation}}”.
review.claimExtract: Left: the control being proposed (written by the model) · Right: the wording in your own document it was drawn from. Check the left against the right.
review.claimGeneric: Left: the proposed content · Right: the evidence it cites.
review.doubtfulHint: Heuristic: the model's own rationale says “does not / not specifically / lacks”, yet the strength still closes the gap. Keyword match, not a verdict.
review.drift: Stated more strongly than the source
review.driftHint: The statement says must/shall, but none of the cited clauses contain a modal verb. Citation checks cannot catch this — the quote is verbatim, the conclusion is not. Tables are a known false positive: they carry obligations without modal verbs.

audit.title: Audit response workspace
audit.subtitle: Capture audit questions and draft traceable answers from internal clauses.
audit.pasteQuestions: Paste one audit question per line
audit.xlsxHint: The first sheet must contain an Audit Question or Question column. Language is optional (English/Chinese or en/zh). Maximum 200 rows.
audit.batchQueued: Queued {{count}} questions. Proposals will appear in the review queue as they complete.
audit.noDraft: No formal draft yet. Generated answers enter the review queue first.
audit.generated: Answer proposal #{{id}} was created. Review it in the queue.

controls.title: Controls
controls.name: Title
controls.extractHint: Choose a parsed, active document. Extraction runs in the background and creates proposals for review.
controls.queued: Extraction queued ({{id}}). Check the review queue for proposals.
controls.limit: Showing up to 100 controls. Narrow your search for more specific results.
controls.noSources: No supporting clauses are linked to this control.
controls.noFrameworkMappings: No external framework mappings are linked to this control.
controls.noImplementations: No implementation is registered for this control.
controls.noEvidence: No evidence is registered for this control.

techAssets.title: Tech asset registry
techAssets.subtitle: The tools, owners, and environments that support control execution
techAssets.name: Name
techAssets.noControls: No applicable controls are linked to this asset.

evidence.title: Evidence library
evidence.subtitle: A register of where evidence is kept and whether it is still fresh

frameworks.title: Frameworks
frameworks.name: Framework
frameworks.importHint: Upload an XLSX or CSV file using the canonical columns; validate it before importing.
frameworks.hasSupporting: Supporting mapping exists but does not close the gap

mapping.alreadyCovered: This framework item is already closed by a confirmed mapping ({{controls}}), so confirming this one will not change coverage.
mapping.supportingNoEffect: A supporting mapping here adds nothing at all — the item is not on the gap list.

relations.contextMissing: One of the two controls no longer exists, so this relation cannot be shown side by side. The raw proposal is below.

matrix.title: Import an Excel control matrix
matrix.flow: 1. Upload .xlsx → 2. Check and approve the column mapping → 3. Import rows as proposals → 4. Review the controls.
matrix.approved: Mapping approved. Import now to create pending control proposals.
matrix.result: Created {{count}} control proposals. Review them before they become formal controls.
matrix.resumeHint: Already approved a mapping in the review queue? Select the same file and enter that proposal ID to resume. The server verifies the approved mapping and file.

maturity.title: Maturity assessment
maturity.subtitle: Score documentation and implementation separately, then compare gaps by framework domain.
maturity.noScores: Score at least one domain to see a comparison.
maturity.empty: No maturity assessments yet. Choose a framework to create the first one.
maturity.scaleHint: Scores range from 0 to 4. Rollups include scored leaf items only; unscored items are not treated as zero.
